message: Write down problems that could occur when applying this idea

plan.goal: List the problems that could occur when applying the Sync-Gate (feedback-controlled D/G update ratio) idea.

args.instruction: Stress-test the Sync-Gate idea (closed-loop PI controller adjusting D:G update ratio using an EMA of mean D(G(z)) as a desynchronization proxy). Identify concrete problems that could occur when applying it in practice: e.g. failure modes of the proxy signal itself (does mean D(G(z)) reliably indicate desync, or can it be misleading near convergence or with non-saturating loss), controller instability or oscillation (tuning Kp/Ki/band), interaction with minibatch noise, added compute/wall-clock overhead from extra D steps, sensitivity to the target band choice, behavior once training uses modern tricks (spectral norm, non-saturating loss) that may already prevent the failure mode, and any risk the controller reacts too late or overcorrects into over-training D. Return these as a revised idea capturing the problems and how serious/likely each is.

steps.why: The user wants the weaknesses/risks of the currently selected idea surfaced, which is a refinement (critique) of that single idea, not new idea generation or a literature lookup.

done_criteria: a revised candidate is returned for idea_eefaec15
it lists multiple distinct potential problems with the approach
